about: What the rule's checks find on the tree and accept, each with its reason. placeholder-copy and disabled-without-reason are counted per file and key by tests/unit/no-inert-surfaces.test.mjs, which requires the tree to hold exactly these counts; inert-control lists data-osc values the browser check no-inert-controls of tests/browser/qa-regressions.cjs accepts without a handler of their own. Entries only shrink: no count may rise above, and no entry return after, its value in an earlier commit. Fixing a W6 or inert entry changes behaviour and is its own pull request, which lowers or removes the entry.

todo.reason: legitimate: 'todo' is the MEASURE flow-step status value (a step not started); the shell compares it to pick the step icon and announces it as 'not started', never as the word
legitimate: the flow-step status value 'todo' (a step not started) that the view sets and the shell maps to 'not started'
legitimate: the class .is-todo styles a flow step whose status value is 'todo' (not started)

mock.reason: legitimate: the ?mock=1 layout-comparison mode (the query key and the class osc-mock), the geometry-only mockup the owner allowed: it outlines renderer hosts and shows no value
legitimate: the .osc-mock outlines of the ?mock=1 layout-comparison mode, geometry only: an outline and the host's name, never data or a trace

not implemented.reason: legitimate: the honest status text 'not implemented by this build', which says that an experiment names an analysis algorithm this build does not know
